name: asana
description: Work with Asana tasks, projects, and workspaces using a personal access token. Load for task lists, reads, and creating/updating tasks.

content.inline:
## Asana
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://app.asana.com/api/1.0` with `bearerSecret: "s/ASANA_TOKEN"` (a personal access token from app.asana.com -> Settings -> Apps -> Developer apps -> Personal access tokens). Responses wrap results in `{data: ...}`. Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Me: `GET /users/me`
- Workspaces: `GET /workspaces`
- My tasks: `GET /tasks?assignee=me&workspace={gid}&completed_since=now&opt_fields=name,due_on,completed`
- Project tasks: `GET /projects/{project_gid}/tasks?opt_fields=name,assignee.name,due_on`
- One task: `GET /tasks/{task_gid}?opt_fields=name,notes,assignee.name,due_on,completed`
- Create: `POST /tasks` body `{data: {name, workspace, projects?, assignee?, due_on?, notes?}}`
- Update: `POST /tasks/{task_gid}` with `method: "PUT"` and body `{data: {...}}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{errors: [{message}]}`. 401 = bad token; 403 = no access to that resource.
- Ask for `opt_fields` explicitly - Asana returns only gid+name by default. Ids are `gid` strings.
